quests.title: The Mulberry Tree at Louzang
quests.objective: Sit under the great mulberry tree by your home.
quests.objective_zh: 到屋旁的大桑树下坐坐。

quests.title: The Governor's Council
quests.objective: Go into the county town. The governor is calling for men.
quests.objective_zh: 进县城去。太守正在招募人马。

quests.title: The Notice at Zhuo
quests.objective: Read the notice in the town square.

quests.title: The Stranger at the Inn
quests.objective: Go into the village inn.

quests.title: The Peach Garden Oath
quests.objective: Sit at the old men's weiqi board under the great peach tree.
quests.objective_zh: 在大桃树下，坐到两位老人的棋盘前。

quests.title: The Way of Great Peace · I: The Old Man in the Cave
quests.objective: Side story: find the old man in the hills.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：去山中寻找那位老人。

quests.title: The Way of Great Peace · II: The Blue Heaven Is Dead
quests.objective: Side story: hear Zhang Jiao's sermon in Julu.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：到巨鹿听张角传道。

quests.title: The Way of Great Peace · III: Betrayed
quests.objective: Side story: the betrayal in the Yellow Hills.

quests.title: Horses from the North
quests.objective: Meet the horse dealers on the northern trail.

quests.title: First Blood at Daxing Mountain
quests.objective: Go to Daxing Mountain. The Yellow Turbans are marching on Zhuo.
quests.objective_zh: 到大兴山去。黄巾军正向涿郡进发。

quests.title: The Ambush at Qingzhou
quests.objective: Hear the messenger from Qingzhou.
quests.hint: Give ground, and make them follow.
quests.objective_zh: 听青州来的信使怎么说。

quests.title: The Ambush at Qingzhou
quests.objective: Lift the siege of Qingzhou.

quests.title: Lu Zhi's Tent
quests.objective: Report to Lu Zhi in his tent.

quests.title: Yingchuan, Too Late
quests.objective: Go to Changshe, in Yingchuan, and learn how Huangfu Song and Zhu Jun stand.
quests.objective_zh: 去颍川长社，探明皇甫嵩、朱儁的军情。

quests.title: The Cage Cart
quests.objective: Go to Guangzong, where Lu Zhi besieges Zhang Jiao.
quests.objective_zh: 前往广宗，卢植正在那里围攻张角。

quests.title: The Hero of Chaos · I: The Feigned Stroke
quests.objective: Side story: the boyhood of Cao Cao.

quests.title: The Hero of Chaos · II: A Villain in Chaos
quests.objective: Side story: Cao Cao at the gates of Luoyang.

quests.title: The Hero of Chaos · II-b: The Five-Coloured Staves
quests.objective: Side story: the five-coloured staves at the city gates.
quests.title_zh: 乱世英雄·二之二：五色棒

quests.title: The Fire Plan
quests.objective: Side story: the fire plan in the Han camp.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：汉军营中的火攻之计。

quests.title: The Hero of Chaos · III: Red Banners at Changshe
quests.objective: Side story: red banners at Changshe.

quests.title: A Bribe Refused
quests.objective: Shortcut: the envoy on the road.

quests.title: “What Office Do You Hold?”
quests.objective: Head home to Zhuo.

quests.title: Black Wind, Paper Soldiers
quests.objective: Break Zhang Bao's sorcery in the hills.

quests.title: The Shrine at the Roadside
quests.objective: Go to the roadside shrine where the glow has begun.
quests.objective_zh: 去路旁那座发光的神龛。

quests.title: The General of Earth Falls
quests.objective: Defeat Zhang Bao at Yangcheng.

boss.title: Zhang Bao, General of Earth
boss.taunt: Wind and thunder answer to me! Your little band will be swept away like dust.
boss.taunt_zh: 风雷听我号令！你们这点人马，一阵风便扫个干净！

quests.title: The Inspector's Visit
quests.objective: Meet the inspector at the posting station.

quests.title: The Hitching Post
quests.objective: Go to the county office, where the old villagers are gathering.
quests.objective_zh: 到县衙前，老人们正聚在那里。
